mapper.select: select up.id, up.username, up.email, r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.description from user_profile up LEFT JOIN role r on up.role_id = r.id

SELECT up.id, up.username, up.email, r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.description FROM user_profile up LEFT JOIN role r on up.role_id = r.id WHERE up.username like concat('%', #{username}, '%') LIMIT 1;
select up.id, up.username, up.email, r.role_name, lr.question, lr.status from list_request lr join user_profile up on lr.user_profile_id = up.id join role r on up.role_id = r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (username, email, role_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, (select rol.id from role rol where rol.id = #{role.id}))
